posts.headline: Tyrique14 finally has the ring, but the Thicks have to prove one championship wasn't a fluke.
posts.detail: A 14-14 career record and an average finish of 5.5 says this is a middling roster that got hot once — the league's reigning champs are the most beatable

posts.headline: Put it in Ra is the best team without a ring in this league, and that's the most Cowboys thing imaginable.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record, a 1.5 average finish, and back-to-back top-2 finishes — One Nut Barner has done everything except close the deal, and until he does, that title-less resume is a glaring hole in the trophy case.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh is drafting into the exact same disaster that produced a 4-10 season and a league-worst 12th place finish.
posts.detail: Chauncey's lone season on record is the definition of bottom-feeder futility — a .286 win percentage and dead last finish, so any preseason confidence here is pure delusion.

posts.headline: Sasinci's World has a title, but Megamind's 13-15 career mark says that ring might be the last good thing that ever happens to this roster.
posts.detail: One championship two seasons ago is aging fast next to a below-.500 career record and a 5.5 average finish — Big Head needs a big draft or this becomes a one-hit wonder story.

posts.headline: Championshipsovercoochie has never finished better than 4th, and the African Bald Fraud nickname is starting to feel generous.
posts.detail: A dead-even 15-13 career record with a suspiciously flat avgFinish of exactly 4.0 across two seasons screams 'permanently average' — draft day is this fraud's only chance to break the pattern.
